title: 5% KOH solution vs placebo treatment of actinic keratosis with different treatment duration
official: Prospective, multistage, two-arm, randomised, double-blind study on the efficacy and safety of treatment of mild to moderate actinic keratosis with a 5% potassium hydroxide solution versus placebo with different duration of treatment cycles
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the study is to demonstrate the superiority of the clinical efficacy of solcera (5% potassium hydroxide solution) for mild to moderate actinic keratosis compared to placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years and < 90 years
2. (At least one) palpable and/or clinically/dermatoscopically apparent actinic keratosis (lesion) severity grade I (mild) or II (moderate) according to Olsen
3. Lesion(s) that is/are either easily accessible/treatable by the patient or - in the case of at least one lesion that is difficult to reach - availability of an assistant to be trained by the investigator before the first application of the investigational product, who will take over the treatment for the duration according to the protocol
4. Written informed consent of the patient
Exclusion criteria:
1. Number of lesions ≥ 6
2. Other disruptive skin disease in the area intended for treatment
3. Pharmacological or physical local therapy of actinic keratosis (or application of the active substances used for pharmacological therapy) in the area intended for treatment during the last 4 weeks
4. Primary or secondary immunodeficiency
5. Treatment with interferons, interferon inducers, immunomodulators or systemic corticosteroids during the last 4 weeks
6. Treatment with oral isotretinoin in the last 6 months
7. Known tendency to excessive scarring
8. Known intolerance/hypersensitivity to any of the components of the investigational medicinal products, in particular parabens
9. Known serious mental illness or risk of suicide
10. Other serious illnesses which, in the opinion of the investigator, prevent participation
11. Obvious unreliability, unwillingness to cooperate or expected withdrawal of consent
12. Size of the total lesion area > 25 cm2
13. Known alcohol, medication or drug addiction
14. Limited legal capacity
15. Court/official order for placement in an institution
16. Dependence on the sponsor or an investigator
17. Participation in a clinical trial in the last 30 days
18. Previous participation in this clinical trial
19. Participation of a relative (in the same household) of the patient in this clinical trial
20. Lesion diameter > 20 mm (largest diameter)
21. Actinic keratosis (lesion) severity grade III (severe) according to Olsen
22. Lesion in the immediate vicinity of the eyes, nostrils or mouth or mucous membranes, respectively
23. Need for extensive treatment of a cancerized area
24. Presence of a recurrent, persistent, indurated, thickened, painful, bleeding, ulcerating and/or rapidly growing lesion
25. Existing skin cancer (all forms of skin cancer incl. basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma) in the area intended for treatment
26. Skin injuries, infected skin areas or dermatitis exfoliativa in the area intended for treatment
